# Web UI ↔ API map

<!-- Generated by `pnpm -C web gen:ui-map` from `web/src/api/uiFeatures.ts`; do not edit. -->

Every web UI feature and the public daemon endpoints it calls (PP-16, E-4, G-5). `web/src/api/uiApiMap.test.ts` fails when a feature has no endpoint, when web code opens a network connection outside `web/src/api/`, or when an endpoint is missing from `docs/specs/openapi.json`.

Coverage: 135 features, 196 of 246 endpoints used by the UI, 50 listed below with a reason.

## Features

## Endpoints without a UI feature

| Endpoint (scope) | Reason |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /v1/accounts` (read) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `POST /v1/agents` (admin) | The CLI keeps it (`openside team hire`); Settings has no add-a-teammate form, the assistant hires. |
| `GET /v1/agents/{id}` (read) | The sidebar and chats read the roster from GET /v1/agents, which carries every field the UI shows. |
| `PATCH /v1/agents/{id}` (steer) | The CLI keeps it (`openside team rename`, `hide`, `unhide`); the setup guide no longer names the assistant and Settings has no teammate profile editor. |
| `GET /v1/agents/{id}/handoffs` (read) | Hand-offs are opened by agents and by `openside` clients; a thread shows them as hand-off cards from its own events, never as a list. |
| `POST /v1/agents/{id}/handoffs` (steer) | Hand-offs are opened by agents and by `openside` clients; people ask a teammate for work by writing in its thread. |
| `POST /v1/agents/{id}/restore` (admin) | Every session is a chat with no teammate threads, so nothing in the web UI brings a retired teammate back; restoring stays an API action for other clients. |
| `POST /v1/agents/{id}/transfer` (admin) | Moving routines and memory between teammates happens through Retire (POST /v1/agents/{id}/retire, hand over); a separate transfer stays an API action. |
| `GET /v1/browser/person/bridge` (steer) | Extension only: the openside extension in the person's browser keeps this WebSocket open so the daemon can read and drive that browser. |
| `POST /v1/browser/prewarm` (steer) | Conversations belong to people now: focusing a thread's box warms that session (POST /v1/sessions/{id}/prewarm); browser-only warm-up stays for other clients. |
| `DELETE /v1/connections/spaces/{space_id}` (admin) | Removing an account from its card revokes the connection, which deletes the separate profile; the profile id is never shown. |
| `GET /v1/connections/{id}` (admin) | The list carries every field of a connection, so cards never read one on its own. |
| `POST /v1/devices/pair` (admin) | Local socket only: token minting for `openside token create`. |
| `GET /v1/doctor` (admin) | The CLI keeps the checks (`openside doctor`, run on the computer); Settings has no Diagnostics page and the Vault page points at the command. |
| `GET /v1/extension/import/{ticket}` (read) | Native delivery for the browser extension: it fetches the one-use ticket with its own device token and verifies the signature before writing; the payload never passes through a web page. |
| `POST /v1/hooks/{kind}/{account_id}` (public) | Public ingress that Slack and Discord post to, signed by the platform and never called by the UI; each account's row shows this address with a copy button. |
| `GET /v1/import/jobs/{id}/events` (admin) | The guide polls GET /v1/import/jobs/{id}; the SSE stream is available to other local clients. |
| `GET /v1/mcp/servers/{id}` (read) | The MCPs tab reads every server from the list; one server's detail is for the CLI and other clients. |
| `GET /v1/memory` (read) | Settings edits memory through the MEMORY.md, USER.md and TAXONOMY.md file views; agents and the CLI use the per-item endpoints. |
| `POST /v1/memory` (admin) | Settings edits memory through the MEMORY.md, USER.md and TAXONOMY.md file views; agents and the CLI use the per-item endpoints. |
| `DELETE /v1/memory/{id}` (admin) | Settings edits memory through the MEMORY.md, USER.md and TAXONOMY.md file views; agents and the CLI use the per-item endpoints. |
| `GET /v1/memory/{id}` (read) | Search hits already carry the full memory. |
| `PATCH /v1/memory/{id}` (admin) | Settings edits memory through the MEMORY.md, USER.md and TAXONOMY.md file views; agents and the CLI use the per-item endpoints. |
| `GET /v1/memory/{id}/history` (read) | Settings edits memory through the MEMORY.md, USER.md and TAXONOMY.md file views; agents and the CLI use the per-item endpoints. |
| `POST /v1/otp` (otp_ingest) | Machine endpoint for an SMS forwarder holding the `otp_ingest` scope. |
| `POST /v1/policy/test` (read) | Policy dry run for the CLI (`openside policy test`); Aside's Agents page has no try-an-action row, so the web shows none. |
| `GET /v1/projects/{id}` (read) | The project list already carries every field of a project, so screens never read one on its own. |
| `GET /v1/remote/local-access` (admin) | Local socket only: `openside-browser` and `openside remote local-access` read the per-boot proof and hand it to the page in the launch link fragment; the page never requests it. |
| `GET /v1/routines/{id}` (read) | The routine list already carries every field. |
| `PUT /v1/sessions/{id}/account` (steer) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models account`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/computer-use` (read) | The card follows the frames stream, whose first event is this same state; the route serves the CLI and other clients. |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/queue/{mid}/move` (steer) | Not offered in the web UI: the queue offers edit, delete and send now; reordering stays an API action. |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/repl` (browse) | Machine endpoint (`browse` scope) for sandboxed tools, MCP servers and extensions. |
| `GET /v1/sessions/{id}/subagents` (read) | The subagent panel is built from `subagent.*` events. |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/subagents/{sid}/steer` (steer) | People steer work by talking to the agent that started it; Task units and the agents sheet are read-only. Steering stays an API action for other clients. |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/tools/{name}` (browse) | Machine endpoint (`browse` scope) for the CLI, MCP servers and scripts driving a session's browser and human-step tools directly; the tickets it opens appear in the web UI as usual. |
| `GET /v1/settings/keys` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside key`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `PATCH /v1/settings/keys/{provider}/{key_id}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside key`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/settings/oauth/accounts` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/settings/oauth/accounts/{provider}/{account_id}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `PATCH /v1/settings/oauth/accounts/{provider}/{account_id}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/settings/subscriptions` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `POST /v1/settings/subscriptions/{source}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/settings/subscriptions/{source}/{account_id}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `PATCH /v1/settings/subscriptions/{source}/{account_id}` (admin) | Model accounts beyond connect and disconnect are managed from the CLI (`openside models accounts`); Aside's Models page has no such controls. |
| `GET /v1/team/proposals/suppressed` (read) | The CLI keeps it (`openside team proposals`); Settings has no list of turned-off suggestions since the Team page went away. |
| `DELETE /v1/team/proposals/{key}` (admin) | The CLI keeps it (`openside team proposals`); Settings has no list of turned-off suggestions since the Team page went away. |
| `GET /v1/tickets/{id}` (read) | Ticket cards come from `ticket.*` events of the open session. |
| `GET /v1/tools` (read) | Machine endpoint: the catalog `openside mcp` and `openside browser tools` build their direct browser tools from. |
| `GET /v1/vault/audit` (admin) | CLI only (`openside vault audit`): Aside's Passwords page has no audit log, so the web shows none. |
